Former defence secretary John Healey has said the government's current plans to fund the military in the coming years fall "well short" of what is required.

Making a Commons speech after his dramatic resignation last week, he told MPs that readying Britain for an uncertain world was the "duty of our political generation".

The PM says he doesn't think his poodle-mix would "get along" with Larry the cat, who has lived at No 10 for 15 years.

The new prime minister told Laura Kuenssberg that people "voted for a manifesto" that he would honour, when pressed on whether there will be an early general election.

See inside Andy Burnham's first week in charge, with an exclusive behind the scenes look with Laura Kuenssberg.

The BBC's Sarah Smith looks at how the new UK prime minister will manage his most crucial, and perhaps the trickiest, international relationship.

Andy Burnham spoke outside Downing Street after he replaced Keir Starmer as prime minister and leader of the Labour party.

A warmer and less confrontational tone than usual was struck during Sir Keir Starmer's final PMQs appearance as prime minister.

The prime minister and opposition leader spoke after the police announced a murder investigation into the death of Ann Widdecombe.

In a statement filmed by Reform UK Nigel Farage announced he will resign as an MP to trigger a by-election which he will stand in.

Trump was more 'funny' than he had been expecting, Morgan McSweeney told the BBC.

Donald Trump gives his first public reaction to the prospect of Andy Burnham becoming prime minister.

Andy Burnham delivers his victory speech after Makerfiled by-election.

Political turmoil continued in Westminster on Thursday after Health Secretary Wes Streeting resigned Starmer's government saying he had "lost confidence" in his leadership.

King Charles III has unveiled the government's agenda in a speech to Parliament.
